title: SM ST6C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST6C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} sets the regulator proportional gain, {Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IA (pu/s)} sets the regulator integral gain, {Pre-control gain constant of the inner loop field voltage regulator, K_FF (pu)} sets the pre-control gain constant of the inner-loop field voltage, {Forward gain of inner loop field regulator, K_M (pu)} sets the forward gain of inner-loop field regulator, {Feedback gain constant of the inner loop field voltage regulator, K_G (pu)} sets the feedback gain constant of the inner-loop field voltage, {Feedback time constant of inner loop field voltage regulator, T_G (s)} sets the feedback time constant of the inner-loop field voltage, {Maximum voltage regulator output, V_Amax (pu)}, {Minimum voltage regulator output, V_Amin (pu)}, {Maximum regulator output limit, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output limit, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Maximum rectifier output limit, V_Mmax (pu)}, {Minimum rectifier output limit, V_Mmin (pu)}, {Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} sets the equivalent time constant of thyristor bridge firing, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Exciter output current limiter gain, K_LR (pu)}, {Exciter output current limit reference, I_LR (pu)}, {Exciter output current limit adjustment, K_CI (pu)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit gain coefficient, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)}, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} sets the maximum available exciter field voltage and {Power source selector}. Values come from the instance.
